t: You're looking at St Paul's Cross, a monument put up in 1910. It stands as a memorial, and Paul the Apostle is depicted on it. Paul was an early Christian apostle who spread the teachings of Jesus in the first century and founded several Christian communities in Asia Minor and Europe. The monument was designed by the architect Reginald Blomfield, and the sculptor Bertram Mackennal made it. Mackennal was an Australian who found success in Britain, and he was the first Australian artist to be knighted.
